name: Arcanes
storyline:
Lyff was a human baby, found alone inside the trunk of an oak by Onirio, elven king of Lunethiel, and his daughter On'illia.
He was raised as a native of Lunethiel, learning the wisdom, culture and customs of the elves from an early age. As he grows up he begins his training as a Lunethi warrior — but along the way he discovers that his origins and his destiny hide far more than he was ever told.
Now a teenager, Lyff must pass through the Ancient Gate and bring back drops of Lunra, the Moon Tree — the trial that opens the way out of the village. That is where the demo begins: from there on, every monster defeated, every NPC heard out and every ruin explored gives back a piece of what happened to Luffendor, and of what Lyff really is.
summary: Arcanes is a metroidvania with a heavy focus on exploration: the world is open from the start, monsters drop items that become resources for upgrading your gear. Players follow Lyff, a human found as a baby and raised by the elves of Lunethiel, who discovers that his origins hide more than he was told.
